name: loomascale
description: LoomaScale plugins for Google Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook Ads and Instagram Ads), LinkedIn Ads, Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console and Google Merchant Center, including competitor analysis and ad research.

plugins.name: loomascale
plugins.description: Google Ads audits, campaign management and keyword research with LoomaScale. Analyze competitors' public Google Ads and Meta Ads creatives, messaging, offers and disclosed landing pages. Also connects Meta Ads (Facebook Ads and Instagram Ads), LinkedIn Ads, Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Tag Manager (GTM), Google Search Console (GSC) and Google Merchant Center (GMC). Review performance and conversion tracking; preview supported changes for your approval.
plugins.displayName: Google Ads & Competitor Analysis by LoomaScale

plugins.name: loomascale-ga4
plugins.description: Analyze Google Analytics 4 traffic, conversions, revenue and funnels. Change key events and stream settings after a dry run and your approval.

plugins.name: loomascale-gtm
plugins.description: Audit Google Tag Manager conversion tracking, draft workspace fixes, and publish only a container version you confirm.

plugins.name: loomascale-gsc
plugins.description: Google Search Console SEO analysis: compare organic traffic, find keyword opportunities and low-CTR pages, check indexing, and submit sitemaps on request.

plugins.name: loomascale-gmc
plugins.description: Fix Google Merchant Center product disapprovals and feed errors, review Shopping performance, and update product data on request.
